waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Here's what's happening in Tesoro Highlands this weekend.

🎃 *Sat 9 AM* — Gilchrist Farm Harvest Festival & Pumpkin Patch
   Free admission, perfect for little ones and families.
🌾 *Sat 8:30 AM* — Old Town Newhall Farmers Market (free)
   Sunday morning local farmers market, great for breakfast and browsing.
🎸 *Fri 4 PM* — Loud @ the Library: Powered by Music Lab 🎸 (free)
   Music Lab live performance at the library—free and fun for kids.
🎵 *Sun 1 PM* — Afternoon Acoustic Jam (free)
   Acoustic jam for adults who love live local music.
🎢 *Fri 6:30 PM* — Fright Fest at Six Flags Magic Mountain (admission varies)
   Halloween thrills at Six Flags for older kids and adults.
🥕 *Sun 8 AM* — Santa Clarita Certified Farmers Market (free)
   Farmers market Sunday morning, fresh local produce and community.

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
